what_it_does: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) lets you compute on encrypted data without decrypting it—your phone can send data to a cloud server and get results back without ever showing the server the plaintext. But the encryption/decryption math is brutally expensive (10,000x slower than plaintext). ABC-FHE accelerates client-side FHE operations using a specialized hardware approach: a flexible Fourier engine that switches between two transform algorithms (NTT and FFT depending on which is faster for current parameters), on-chip random number generation, and smart task scheduling that minimizes slow memory accesses.
